newsitem.title: USA: M.A.Hanna sees Q3-4 revenues up about 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: M.A.Hanna sees Q3-4 revenues up about 14 pct.

text.p: M.A. Hanna Co President Douglas McGregor said Monday the company expects its third and fourth-quarter 1996 revenues to be about 14 percent above the 1995 second half total of $925.9 million.
About half the increase will come from acquisitions made earlier this year, he said.
"Revenues for the third and fourth quarter appear to be up a total of about 14 percent quarter over quarter, with about seven points of that from acquisitions," he said in a telephone interview.

For the year, revenues are expected to be near $2.1 billion, or about 10 percent above 1995's $1.9 billion, he said. "For the whole year, it's about 10 percent overall," again with about half from acquisitions, he said.
Hanna is a specialty chemicals company focusing on plastics and rubber.
